title_zh: WebXSkill：面向自主网页智能体的技能学习
one_line: WebXSkill retrieves verified, parameterized browser skills with step guidance; ablations and cross-site live evaluations show improved task completion.
one_line_zh: 检索可执行技能与逐步指导，消融和跨站实测显示任务成功率提升。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate on three popular web agent benchmarks. WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) provides five self-hosted websites

held_out_env.quote: We test it with only WebArena skills (Guided + WA) and it reaches 85.1% without target-site programs, a 10.7 point gain over MAP on WebVoyager

strong_baselines.quote: We compare against (1) Vanilla , a ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) agent without skills; (2) MAP (Multi-Action Prediction), which generates up to 3 browser actions per step; (3) SkillWeaver ( Zheng et al., 2025 )

budget_matched.quote: All methods use a 30 interaction step budget.

cost_reported.quote: For step efficiency, Grounded mode achieves 9.3 average steps with higher success rate, fewer steps than Vanilla. Guided mode uses slightly more steps as the agent needs to take action by action, trading efficiency for adaptability.

validator_check.quote: For benchmark evaluation, we follow the default settings by each benchmark and use GPT-4.1 if required for LLM judge.

code.quote: The code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebXSkill.

evidence_level.quote: We test it with only WebArena skills (Guided + WA) and it reaches 85.1% without target-site programs, a 10.7 point gain over MAP on WebVoyager

S1.quote: Skills are extracted by SynthAgent ( Wang et al., 2026 ) on synthetic tasks for each benchmark website.

S3.quote: Expanding from 25% of the corpus to the full set grows the library from 105 to 591 skills, raises task success from 62.8% to 69.5%, and increases UR from 26.6% to 70.8%.

S5.quote: both deployment modes of WebXSkill outperform all baselines on the overall metric for both backbones, confirming that executable skills reduce planning errors and improve task completion.

F1.quote: We test it with only WebArena skills (Guided + WA) and it reaches 85.1% without target-site programs, a 10.7 point gain over MAP on WebVoyager

F3.quote: We test it with only WebArena skills (Guided + WA) and it reaches 85.1% without target-site programs, a 10.7 point gain over MAP on WebVoyager

F4.quote: Failure attribution shows that post-skill reasoning (38%) is the largest failure category: skills executed successfully but the agent failed at subsequent steps.

F5.quote: We retrieve the closest WebArena test task for each synthetic source, classify workflow and goal similarity with GPT-5, and remove 196 near-matching sources before rebuilding the library.

AP4.quote: For benchmark evaluation, we follow the default settings by each benchmark and use GPT-4.1 if required for LLM judge.

AP5.quote: We test it with only WebArena skills (Guided + WA) and it reaches 85.1% without target-site programs, a 10.7 point gain over MAP on WebVoyager

AP8.quote: following recent work ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) , we use its cleaned 154 task subset.

title_zh: 成功则强化，失败则慢学：面向移动应用控制的高样本效率离策略强化学习
one_line: SoLS conservatively updates negative-advantage actions and replays successes; three-run AndroidWorld results outperform matched SFT and RL baselines with faster inference.
one_line_zh: 负优势保守更新配合成功经验回放，三轮安卓实测优于同骨干基线。

online_eval.quote: Success rates of different agent methods in the AndroidWorld environment, across task difficulty levels.

variance.quote: For models that do not require proprietary access, we average results over three evaluation runs and report two standard errors for the overall success rate.

strong_baselines.quote: To further highlight the contribution of our asymmetric update mechanism, we compare SoLS with standard A2C using identical STR parameters.

cost_reported.quote: SoLS occupies the best position in the bottom-right quadrant, achieving the highest success rate (51.3%) while maintaining the fastest inference time ( \sim 0.9 seconds).

component_ablation.quote: Figure 2(a) presents the success rates of PPO, DigiRL, and SoLS with and without STR.

evidence_level.quote: Success rates of different agent methods in the AndroidWorld environment, across task difficulty levels.

S1.quote: As a first step, we fine-tune our base model through SFT on AndroidControl, which shares observation and action space similarities with AndroidWorld.

S2.quote: In contrast to the original PPO objective, which restricts policy updates when A<0 and only when the importance sampling ratio falls below 1-\epsilon , our approach introduces a symmetric constraint by also restricting updates when the importance sampling ratio exceeds 1+\epsilon .

F1.quote: SoLS can be combined with STR without pruning the updates of positive samples due to small or large values in the importance sampling.

F2.quote: STR thus creates a bridge between the SFT and target distributions, by bootstrapping from rare successes to build a repository of successful interactions specific to the environment.

F4.quote: In this work, we use Llama-3-8B-Instruct [ 12 ] for approximating the policy.

AP14.quote: other tasks might depend on visual input, either directly through images or because the textual representation of certain items, such as mazes, is inadequate.

AP18.quote: Although SoLS is provided with a history of actions, a history of observations is not, due to context-length restrictions and concerns about information overload.

title_zh: OmegaUse-SOP：从人类演示构建专业计算机操作的标准流程

one_line_zh: 将专家演示抽象为可配置操作规程，五项专业软件实测显示完成率提升。
